name: Clavell Tower (Landmark Trust)
accommodation: Four-storey tower sleeping 2: one double bedroom, shower room, kitchen
parking: One guest space about 250m away at the bottom of the cliff
dogs: Up to two dogs welcome for a charge
beachAccess: Stands directly above Kimmeridge Bay; coast path passes the door; 10-minute steep walk from parking
confirmedFeatures: Balcony, fully equipped kitchen, storage heaters and underfloor heating, weak or no mobile signal
overview: A restored four-storey folly on the cliff above Kimmeridge Bay, let by the Landmark Trust and sleeping two. Each room is on its own floor, the South West Coast Path runs past the door, and the guest parking space is about 250 metres below up a steep, stepped path.
surfTripFit: Wakes you right above the Kimmeridge ledges, though boards have to be carried up a steep path from the car.
